import re

def strip_leading_prose(text: str) -> str:
    # Regular expression to match lines that are not valid Python statements
    non_code_line_pattern = re.compile(r'^[^#\'"a-zA-Z0-9]+')

    code_lines = [line for line in lines if not non_code_line_pattern.match(line)]
    
    # Join the remaining lines back together
